But SAM operates in isolation: it runs independently of any CRM, client data platform, or enterprise AI layer. Advisors use AI for financial planning while manually managing their client relationships in parallel. Mubadala acquired CI Financial for C$12.1B as a strategic, long-term investment — its portfolio includes OpenAI, Anthropic, and Databricks.
